entry.title: Threshold of the Surface Code Under Correlated Noise
entry.summary: We study exact error thresholds of the surface code under spatially correlated noise. Using a mapping to a statistical mechanics model, we compute the threshold for various noise channels.

entry.title: Noise and Decoherence in NISQ-Era Quantum Processors
entry.summary: We characterize decoherence channels in superconducting qubits and analyze their impact on variational quantum algorithm performance.
